text:
ryan: heads-up: ran the new packing regressor over a 12h production trace and saw a surge in single-item microbatches for mid-length prompts (approx 90-280 tokens). throughput dropped on that slice. tagging you all.
maria: can you paste a tiny trace sample? curious if kv cold-starts are breaking coalescing.
josh: small profile snippet from the window:
```
# window 11:40-11:55
requests: 5.1k
avg_prompt_len: 172
median_decode_rate: 12.1 tok/s
batch_sizes: p50=1 p90=4 p99=8
kv_hit_rate: 0.59
kernel_switch_pct: 21%
```
ryan: that kernel_switch_pct is alarming. looks like the length->kernel mapping flips near ~192 tokens on our A100 flows so a chunk of mid prompts are bouncing to the slower generic kernel.
tina: Hypothesis: classifier boundaries are too coarse (we only have 0-128/128-256/256+). Also the token_budget uses fixed token_target=32 which leaves batches starved when decode_rate is low.
maria: Experimented locally: bumped token_target->48 and added a soft flush timeout of 10ms. staging microbench showed: p50 -5%, p95 -3%, throughput +3%, CPU +6%.
josh: good improvement but need to watch KV eviction. waiting longer increases per-host KV pressure. we saw eviction spikes once avg wait >14ms last month.
ryan: proposal for adjusted rules (sketch):
1) length buckets: short <64, mid 64-320, long >=320
2) add decode-rate buckets: slow <7 tok/s, norm 7-22, fast >22
3) token_target = base[length] * rate_factor
   base = {short:6, mid:28, long:72}
   rate_factor = clamp(0.6, 0.45 + median_rate/18, 1.9)
This reduces target for slow decoders, increases for fast.
tina: Also add kernel-selection hysteresis: require two consecutive window samples before switching kernel choice for an allocation. that should cut flapping.
josh: ran a quick local run with hysteresis=2 windows: kernel_switch_pct -> 5% (from 21%), p95 down 8%.
maria: I'll run a simple KV eviction simulator with the new wait distribution and report delta. if eviction_delta < +5% we can canary.
ops-bot: canary deploy v0.12.7 to staging completed :white_check_mark:
ryan: Canary plan: stage1 10% traffic with new classifier/token_target/hysteresis. monitor p95 latency, kernel_switch_pct, kv_evictions, batch_size p90. rollback if p95 > baseline_p95 + 7% or kv_evictions > baseline +5%.
josh: I'll own the stage1 rollout and alert config (alert:eng-runtime|microbatch_p95 > threshold -> page).
maria: sim summary paste: eviction_delta +1.6%, avg_batch_wait 11.2ms (prev 9.4ms). looks within tolerance.
tina: small operational note: persist the classifier training snapshot and the misclassified sample ids for 48h post-canary so we can debug boundary cases.
ops-bot: starting canary at 2360005400
ryan: logging this thread, we'll reconvene after ~3h of canary telemetry. thanks all. :rocket:
